title: chore(release): exit Changesets pre mode (`next`), so the next `chore: release packages` PR renders objectui's 18.0.0 GA
body:
**Filing gate ③: a task the maintainer directed.** The order came in objectui `domain:devx` seat 1's chat (`session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`), 2026-10-20, verbatim: 「objectui 退出预发布模式」. It answers the seat's open question, asked after objectstack exited pre mode for its 18.0.0 GA (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24528, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24555). Filed and claimed by that seat (`os-warren`). The lane is `domain:devx`, which owns objectui's build and release pipeline (pm-dispatch `references/lanes/devx.md`).

## Measured (objectui `origin/main` `df943a2a1a`)

- `.changeset/pre.json` reads `{ "mode": "pre", "tag": "next" }`. Its last change is `6f3299fe`, objectui#12334 (PR #12401): "objectui's first 18.x release — the sync major, Changesets pre mode on next, and the two gate edits".
- Every publishable package sits in one `fixed` group (`.changeset/config.json`) at `17.7.0`. `.changeset/12334-objectstack-18-sync-major.md` is the sync major that `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` admits, because it carries the group onto `@objectstack/spec`'s major.
- The open release PR #11600 ("chore: release packages (next)", head `f3b458d3`, refreshed 2026-10-20T00:32:49Z) renders the group at **`18.0.0-next.0`**. objectui has published no 18.x version yet.
- objectstack's 18.0.0 GA Version Packages PR (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24524) renders `18.0.0` and is waiting on the maintainer's release.

## Wanted

- One PR that leaves objectui out of pre mode: `.changeset/pre.json` written by `pnpm changeset pre exit`, in the shape this repo keeps.
- A dry-run of the release workflow's version step (`pnpm changeset:version`, including `sync-quick-reference-release.mjs`), in a scratch clone with that change. It shows that the fixed group renders **`18.0.0`**, not a prerelease, and that every gate the version step and its validation run stays green. Name each one.
- PR #12401's "two gate edits" are read and judged one by one. An edit that exists only for pre mode is reversed in the same PR. An edit that holds for GA stays, and the PR body says why. ⛔ No gate is weakened, and ⛔ no new gate is added.
- Release text, if objectui has any that states a prerelease or "no GA" status (the quick-reference sync or a release page), follows in the same PR so the render goes green. This mirrors objectstack-ai/objectstack#24569.
- The PR stays **draft**, and the maintainer merges it, because the merge is the GA timing call (as with objectstack-ai/objectstack#24555). ⛔ No release act by any seat: no merge or queueing of PR #11600, no publish.

## Order note (for the maintainer, not a gate)

objectui's packages depend on `@objectstack/*` at `^18.0.0-next.N` ranges, which `18.0.0` satisfies. `changeset:publish` runs `scripts/objectstack-floor.mjs` and `check-spec-range-floors.mjs` first. The dev measures what those require of the `@objectstack` versions on npm when objectui 18.0.0 publishes, and says whether objectstack 18.0.0 must be on `latest` first.

## Dedupe

Searched objectui issues for "exit pre mode", "pre.json exit" and "18.0.0 GA release packages": none open on this. objectui#12334, closed, entered pre mode.
